name: update_sprite_position_and_blit
description: Adds the velocity words to the object's position, clamps the position to the screen limits, and reverses or zeroes the velocity at the edges. It then fills the blitter register block with the object's image, mask and destination pointers and calls the routines that start the draw.

name: clamp_and_clear_pending_position
description: Clears the pending flag when either of two status words is negative. It then clamps the stored x and y pair to the screen range, copies it to the destination pair, and zeroes the source pair.

name: subtract_offsets_when_flags_clear
description: For each of two object slots whose flag word is zero, it calls an unnamed routine and subtracts the paired stored offsets from that slot's x and y words. The second slot update restores a saved pointer first.

name: look_up_proximity_value
description: Takes the absolute x and y differences between a point and a reference point, sums the squares of their high words, and compares the sum to a fixed threshold. Below the threshold it reads a byte from a lookup table, subtracts a scaled penalty from a counter when the byte is small, and returns a table-derived value; otherwise it returns the raw sum.

name: copy_pairs_with_derived_values
description: Loops over a source table of word pairs, copying each first word to two destination tables. It also writes a derived word for each pair, computed from the second source word by shifting it right, masking it and adding a constant, into both destinations.

name: build_two_slot_sprite_table
description: Reads the vertical beam position and compares it with two stored bounds to pick a status value for each of two slots. It then fills a twelve-record table with active or inactive markers, busy-waits on a shared byte, and stores the table end pointer.

name: reset_audio_channels_with_volume
description: Derives a volume level from two channel-enable flags, scales it by shifting, and clears the volume and period registers of the audio channels through unnamed routines. It then writes the DMA control value that enables the channels.

name: read_next_sequence_record
description: If the cursor is null it stores a default start value and a count of two. Otherwise it reads the next three-word record from the cursor, advances the cursor, stores the first two words as the result, and sets a fixed count when the list end is reached.

name: bounce_objects_off_surfaces
description: For two objects that are moving upward and sit on one of three specific tile codes, it calls a check and reverses the vertical velocity when the check succeeds. If the second flag is set it zeroes the velocity and marks a rebound; otherwise it records the surface pointer.

name: resolve_object_contact_states
description: Handles contact results for two object slots: when a slot is in one of three contact states and the probe reports a hit, it resets the state and zeroes the velocity. Depending on the contact class it increments capped counters or records a surface pointer and exits.

name: test_masked_plane_bits
description: Computes a word offset in a bitplane from two coordinates and a table base, reads three plane words, and tests a fixed mask across them. Every branch returns without writing anything, so the routine has no observable effect beyond its early-exit test.

name: advance_global_frame_and_mask
description: When the active flag is set, it steps two global position words by a fixed amount, then either advances a frame counter that wraps at a fixed count or programs a blitter request for the current frame. It also ANDs a mask over a region of 26 shared entries.

name: advance_object_frame_and_blit
description: Advances the frame counter of an object record, wrapping at a fixed count, and on the first frame writes a blitter request built from the object's image pointer and position. It then ANDs a mask over a 26-entry region when the record has a clear-mask pointer.

name: program_blitter_copy_request
description: Waits for the blitter to finish, then programs its control word, first-word masks, source and destination pointers, and fixed modulo and size values. The control word comes from an unnamed routine.

name: program_blitter_three_channel_request
description: Waits for the blitter, then writes its control word combined with a fixed logic-function code. It sets the source, second source and destination pointers and the fixed sizes and modulos for a three-channel blit.

name: update_active_blit_entries
description: Walks ten three-word entries, and for each active entry advances its frame counter. On its first frame it waits for the blitter and programs a copy from a source address computed from the entry's position, and it clears the entry at the final frame.

name: program_blit_after_busy_wait
description: Spins until the blitter-busy bit in the status register clears, then writes the control word combined with a fixed logic-function code. It zeroes the first-word masks and writes the source, second source, destination and size registers.

name: update_two_blit_entries
description: Processes two three-row entries: on each entry's first frame it waits for the blitter and programs a copy, then advances the frame counter and clears the entry at the final frame. For a flagged entry on middle frames it programs a second blit and calls four unnamed routines.

name: compute_clamped_weighted_offset
description: Forms a weighted sum from two inputs and a table entry, scales it by sixteen, and clamps the result to a fixed signed range. It then adds the base value passed in the data registers and returns the total.

name: refresh_two_slot_positions
description: For each of two unflagged slots, it reloads a saved position value when its counter is set, then stores a newly computed position in the slot. It then makes a fixed sequence of ten unnamed routine calls that advance the frame.

name: advance_slot_after_range_check
description: When the first slot is idle and its position is in range, it subtracts a stored step from the position and re-checks it. If both checks pass it advances the slot timer, copies a value into a global, and returns the result of an unnamed check; otherwise it returns one.

name: advance_slot_two_after_check
description: The mirror of the first-slot check for the second slot: when that slot is idle and its position is in range after subtracting a stored step, it advances its timer, copies a value into a global, and returns the result of an unnamed check. Otherwise it returns one.

name: decay_slot_timers_and_flush
description: Clears the pending-update flag for each of two slots and, when a flag was set, runs an unnamed check that may set a pointer and trigger a follow-up call. It then counts each slot timer down by one step, or by three when a control bit is set, and clamps each timer at zero.

name: update_slot_motion_and_reset
description: Applies friction by reducing each slot's velocity by one eighth when its contact check passes, and sets or clears stop flags depending on a status bit. When a slot's remaining counter goes negative it reloads that slot's position, velocity, timers and limit values from stored defaults.

name: apply_fire_thrust_and_move
description: Saves the previous frame's fire flags, then reads the fire-button register to thrust each of two slots while their stored limit is not exhausted. It moves both slots by their velocity, keeps them within the field boundaries, and writes the updated position pairs back.

name: stub_empty_routine
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it has no effect. It is an empty entry point with no side effects.

name: stub_empty_routine
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it has no effect. It is the same no-op entry point as the other empty stubs in this code.

name: pack_joystick_bits_into_byte
description: Packs the two low direction bits and a bit taken from a shared status byte into a per-player state byte, then sets two more bits from the high input bits. It clears two state flags once the state index passes a fixed limit.

name: unpack_joystick_bits_from_byte
description: Rebuilds an input word from a per-player state byte, restoring the two low direction bits, the fire bit and the two high input bits. It clears two state flags once the state index passes the same limit.

name: poll_mouse_and_joystick_ports
description: Reads the mouse-port and joystick-port movement registers through unnamed routines and stores the results into the slot position and state words. It also counts how long each slot's fire button has been held and sets a pending input flag on a new press.

name: load_graphic_file_from_disk
description: Locks and opens a named file through the DOS library, reads its header, and checks the magic words of the expected image format. For a valid file it copies the header and reorders the remaining words into a destination buffer, clears the top bits of the last word, and returns the buffer address and size.

name: derive_color_shade_values
description: Takes a twelve-bit Amiga colour word and stores it, a halved and masked copy of its channels, and the difference that remains. A sign bit selects one of two flags, and a zero value is replaced by a fixed default colour.

name: allocate_tracked_memory_block
description: Finds a free slot in a table of nineteen two-word entries, records the requested size in it, and allocates that many bytes through the exec library. It stores the returned address in the slot, or clears the size when the allocation fails.

name: free_tracked_memory_blocks
description: Walks the tracked-allocation table and, for each entry that holds a live block, marks the slot empty and frees the block through the exec library. Slots marked as released are skipped.

name: free_tracked_block_by_address
description: Searches the tracked-allocation table for a given address and, when it is found, marks that slot as released, clears its size, and frees the block through the exec library. Invalid or zero addresses are ignored.

name: stub_empty_routine
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it has no effect. It is an empty entry point with no side effects.

name: shutdown_and_restore_system
description: Waits for the blitter, restores the saved copper list pointer, and writes an all-clear mask to the DMA and interrupt-request registers. It then re-enables interrupts through the exec library, releases the blitter, restores the view, closes the library and unloads the segment.

name: reply_pending_exec_message
description: If a stored message pointer is set, it calls the exec library's Forbid and then ReplyMsg to return that message to its sender. It always returns zero.

name: draw_nested_rectangle_sequence
description: Computes the midpoint and half-extents of a rectangle from two corner positions, then draws a stepped series of rectangles between those corners. Each draw waits on a synchronisation byte and then calls an unnamed routine that draws the rectangle.

name: fill_bounds_and_offset_grid
description: Stores the bounding box expanded by four units on each side, then fills a grid of longwords by adding a signed offset byte to a table lookup for each entry. A sentinel byte value skips the rest of the record.

name: draw_grid_cells_two_passes
description: Runs a nested loop over a four-row grid, calling an unnamed routine for each cell with the row index and a pointer that advances by a fixed stride. It alternates between two passes and then waits for the blitter to finish.

name: draw_grid_cells_second_layout
description: Performs the same two-pass grid drawing as its sibling routine, but with one extra row per pass. Each cell is drawn by an unnamed routine, and the blitter is waited on at the end.

name: program_blitter_masked_copy
description: Computes a source offset from two coordinates, waits for the blitter, and then writes the control words, the full first-word mask, the source and destination pointers, and the modulos. The modulo and size values come from the coordinate differences.

name: program_blitter_line_draw
description: Computes the absolute horizontal and vertical distances between two points and an octant code for the direction. After waiting for the blitter, it writes the line-mode control words, the error terms, the modulos and the size for drawing the line.

name: build_prefixed_string_copy
description: Writes a digit character and a second character into a work buffer, then appends a null-terminated source string. It copies the assembled string to the destination and clears a counter.

name: await_text_entry_input
description: Copies a prompt string into a buffer, clears the input state, and draws the entries through unnamed routines. It then polls the button and keyboard state in a loop and returns once input is confirmed or cancelled.

name: read_keyboard_text_character
description: Reads a keyboard code from the keyboard serial register and translates it through a symbol table that covers digits and punctuation. It appends printable characters to an input buffer, ends entry on the return or escape codes, and decrements a repeat counter on each call.

name: handle_text_control_codes
description: Stores the argument character for control codes five, seven and eight. It returns a flag that is true for codes five and seven, and for code eight unless the argument is zero and an input-active flag is clear.

name: render_wrapped_text_string
description: Initialises the text layout state, then walks a null-terminated string one character at a time. Each character is drawn by an unnamed routine, and the line breaks at a space when the column passes the right margin.

name: render_text_with_callback
description: Enters the same text loop from a caller-supplied starting position and draws each character with wrapping at spaces past the right margin. When the string ends it calls the callback that was supplied, if any.

name: draw_glyph_with_blitter
description: Computes the position and width of a glyph from its coordinates and a stored offset, then programs the blitter with its masks, pointers, modulos and size. If a second flag is set it programs a second blit with the same parameters at a shifted position.

name: scan_text_for_marker
description: Skips an optional two-character prefix and then scans the string, mapping each character through a five-entry table and skipping ampersands. It stops at the end of the line or at a non-text character and stores zero in the result on each exit.

name: update_fire_button_flags
description: Checks the fire-button register and the button state bits, and resets a limit value to a fixed number when a button is not held. It sets two flags from a position threshold and updates a combined state word used for input-driven motion.

name: toggle_pattern_every_ten_ticks
description: Increments a frame byte and counts down a ten-step timer. When the timer reaches zero it reloads, and two stored words are XORed with a fixed pattern, so they toggle each cycle.

name: multiply_absolute_components
description: Takes absolute values of two signed inputs, multiplies the high word of one by the low word of the other, and returns the product together with the second input's halves swapped.

name: draw_slot_if_in_range
description: Compares the vertical difference between a slot and a reference with a window running from minus sixteen up to, but not including, 107. Inside the window it calls four unnamed routines; outside it clears two status words.

name: draw_when_x_in_window
description: Compares a slot's horizontal position with a reference using the same window test. Inside it calls four unnamed routines; outside it clears one status word, stores a fixed marker, and calls an unnamed routine.

name: initialize_sprite_and_color_tables
description: Fills a table of five pointer records with buffer addresses and a fixed stride, then writes a sequence of colour words and constants for the sprite and copper tables. Finally it stores four specific pointer values into the shared table slots.

name: load_display_state_and_palette
description: Builds a table of three buffer pointers and a fifteen-entry palette from interpolated colour words. It loads position and scroll variables from a configuration block, copies the stored palette into the colour registers, and derives the shade values for the first colour word.

name: initialize_copper_word_pairs
description: Stores a fixed set of address and control word pairs into the shared tables. It then ORs each pair of words from one table into a second table and zeroes every second word.

name: compute_row_pointer_set
description: Clamps a row value to a range derived from a stored height, then computes a row address in a buffer with a 42-byte stride. It stores that address and three further row addresses, each one stride apart, into a record.

name: pack_position_control_words
description: Builds a two-word control entry from a position value and a bit of an input flag, adding a fixed offset that is replaced by an alternate offset when a flag is set. It masks the high byte and stores the result in the destination record.

name: store_position_control_pair
description: Forms a control word from a position value by adding a fixed offset, replacing it with an alternate offset when a flag is set, and clearing the low byte. It sets the low bit from a second input bit and stores the position and control words as a pair.

name: copy_slot_record_or_clear
description: Chooses between two slot status flags depending on which slot the destination belongs to. If the chosen flag is clear it copies a fifteen-word record from a table indexed by the input value; otherwise it zeroes the destination's fifteen words.

name: clear_fifteen_longwords
description: Stores zero into fifteen consecutive longwords starting after the destination pointer. It has no other effect.

name: store_masked_status_bits
description: Masks a shared status value with a fixed bit pattern and stores the result in a state word. It does nothing else.

name: decode_joystick_directions
description: Decodes the mouse-port and joystick-port direction bits from the input words, toggling low bits to correct the quadrature sequence. It stores a signed step for each port, and opposite steps cancel to zero.

name: draw_object_image_records
description: Serves as a short entry into the object drawing code: it clamps a horizontal offset and writes the image records through unnamed routines. It halves the velocity pair when a status bit is clear, and repeats the record writes at stepped positions when a flag is set.

name: draw_object_image_blit
description: Clamps a horizontal offset, waits for the blitter, and programs blits for the object's image through unnamed routines. It halves the velocity pair when a status bit is clear, and repeats the blit at stepped positions when a flag is set.

name: load_level_and_map_files
description: Copies two file-name strings from a level configuration record into a buffer, then loads the named level and tile-map files through an unnamed routine. Interrupts and DMA are switched off around the load and restored afterwards, and the routine loops forever if the loaded data pointer is null.

name: compute_quadrant_lookup_angle
description: Takes absolute values of two signed deltas to determine a quadrant offset, divides the smaller delta by the larger, and looks up a table byte from the top bits of the quotient. It returns that byte adjusted by the quadrant offset.

name: smooth_active_record_values
description: Walks a list of twelve-word records and, for each active record flagged with a particular status bit, moves two stored values a fraction of the way toward a table target. The fraction is set by a shift count stored in the record.

name: update_active_object_records
description: Walks a list of twelve-word records and integrates each active record's position from its velocity. Records that leave the field are deactivated, records inside the field are drawn through an unnamed routine, and records whose countdown ends are cleared.

name: check_plane_point_mask
description: Computes a plane word address from coordinates and a table base, then reads a masked bit from three plane words. Every path returns, so the routine has no visible effect.

name: allocate_record_slot_at_position
description: Searches a table of six-longword records for an empty slot and fills the first free one with a computed position, a velocity-derived pair and fixed defaults. It returns an offset derived from the slot index, or a failure value when no slot is free.

name: build_gf2_assign_copy_command
description: Program entry point that copies the start-up path into a buffer and appends the directory and a separator. It writes an AmigaDOS command line that assigns the GF2 volume, copies the GF2 directory to RAM and names a Start_GF2 target, and returns zero on success or a failure code.

name: open_write_and_close_file
description: Opens a file through the DOS library and, on success, stores the handle, writes the buffer and closes the file. It returns one when the file was opened and zero when the open fails.

name: write_null_terminated_string
description: Scans to the terminating zero byte of a string and then passes the string to the DOS library's write call.

name: open_dos_library_and_console
description: Opens the DOS library and, if that succeeds, opens a console window described by a fixed specification string. It returns zero when both opens succeed and one otherwise.

name: close_console_and_dos_library
description: If a console handle was opened, closes it through the DOS library and then closes the DOS library itself.

name: initialize_global_words_from_input
description: Stores the first input register into about two dozen global words and the second input into a few more. It then returns a fixed constant pair.

name: dispatch_logfile_record_operations
description: Dispatches on a mode argument to one of four operations on a log table: adding or updating a named record, initialising the header, verifying a checksum, and writing summary lines. The table is tied to the log file named in the data.

name: copy_base_name_before_dot
description: Copies the file name passed in the argument into a buffer, stopping before its first dot. When the copied name matches the default buffer it resets the name pointers, and it marks the label as absent when the first argument is zero.

name: format_two_digit_percentage
description: Writes a two-digit value equal to one hundred minus the first input into the text buffer. For records that start with one of two recognised signatures it also computes a second two-digit percentage from stored size fields and writes it.

name: format_status_label_with_dashes
description: Writes a parenthesised status label into the output buffer: two dashes, a closing parenthesis, and then a digit of three or four for each of two stored fields, depending on whether that field is nonzero. It sets two output positions afterwards.

name: append_plural_suffix_text
description: Writes several zero-terminated output positions, then appends either a plural ending or a plain period depending on a stored count. It then copies in a fixed text string.

name: format_elapsed_hours_minutes
description: Converts a count of time units into hours and minutes and writes them as text, choosing the singular or plural word for each unit. When there are no hours it writes only the minutes, and when there are no minutes it stops after the hours.

name: format_unsigned_decimal_number
description: Writes an optional two-byte prefix when a flag is set, then converts a 32-bit value to decimal digits by repeated subtraction of descending powers of ten. Leading zeros are suppressed, and a zero value is written as a single zero digit.

name: clear_buffer_and_set_terminator
description: Zeroes 120 bytes at the buffer pointer held in the record, then stores a sentinel value of minus two into the word that the record points to.

name: store_buffer_checksum_word
description: Sums the longwords of a buffer after a fixed header, then stores the negated sum XORed with a fixed signature word at the start of the buffer.

name: xor_scramble_words_backward
description: Walks a buffer backwards one word at a time, replacing each word with the XOR of itself, its successor and a fixed key. The number of words is derived from the input length.

name: xor_scramble_words_forward
description: Walks a buffer forwards one word at a time, replacing each word with the XOR of itself, the next word and a fixed key. The number of words is derived from the input length.

name: insert_or_update_named_record
description: Searches a table of 25-word records for a matching key. If none matches it appends a new record holding the key, a copy of the name and the computed value; if one matches, it replaces the stored value when the new value is smaller and copies the name.

name: decode_packed_tile_image
description: Unpacks a tile image from a packed buffer described by its header into a work area, after XORing a shared key byte. It walks the tile cells, computing a first-word mask for each column, and stores the final table pointer before returning.

name: blit_packed_tile_image
description: Unpacks a packed tile image in the same way as its neighbouring routine, then programs the blitter for each tile cell with its masks, shift, modulos and size. It stores the saved table pointer when finished.

name: scroll_row_block_upward
description: Moves a block of twenty-word rows within a buffer by one row, clearing the row that is emptied at the bottom. It finishes by storing the saved table pointer.

name: wait_until_blitter_idle
description: Spins while the blitter-busy bit of the DMA status register is set, then returns.

name: decode_run_length_image
description: Checks a two-byte header signature, then decodes a run-length compressed image using a marker byte from the header. A marker is followed by a count and a value that is repeated, and a special count value copies the marker byte literally; it returns zero on success and a negative code on failure.

name: fill_memory_with_byte
description: Fills a block of memory with a byte value, aligning to a word boundary first. It then writes four copies of the byte per longword and finishes any remaining bytes.

name: open_logfile_with_fallback
description: Opens the log file through the DOS library. If the open fails it sets the background colour register to a fixed red shade in a long loop; otherwise it stores the handle and writes and closes the file.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Decodes to a single unimplemented instruction, so the body is only a halt marker with no behaviour to describe. It is library code in the math library's disk file.

name: store_argument_to_global
description: Copies the address register argument into a library global longword and returns. It is library code in the math library.

name: unlink_node_and_free
description: If the node's flag is clear, it joins the node's neighbours to unlink it, frees the node through the exec library, and returns the stored library result. Otherwise it sets a flag bit in the node and returns zero.

name: set_node_flag_return_zero
description: Sets bit three of the status byte at offset fourteen in the structure and returns zero.

name: open_library_on_first_use
description: If the structure's flag bit is clear, it increments a use count and on the first use calls a routine with the name string for the mathffp library and a zero version. It returns the structure pointer, or minus one when the flag bit is set.

name: decrement_counter_and_call
description: Decrements a short counter at offset 32 in the structure. When the counter reaches zero and a flag bit is set, it calls one routine and returns its result, and when the counter reaches zero it also calls a second routine with a stored value.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls one other routine and returns, passing through no result of its own.

name: normalise_float_mantissa
description: Converts a value to a normalised mantissa by repeated shifting and subtraction over up to twenty-three steps, using a hidden leading bit. Zero returns immediately, and a negative value is handed to another routine.

name: refine_bit_serial_result
description: Sets one bit of the result per pass, using a doubling accumulator and a shifting trial value, until the trial value turns non-negative or the bit counter runs out. It then rounds the result up by one when a nonzero remainder remains, and returns the result with the final bit counter.

name: call_vector_and_set_flags
description: Calls a library vector through the library base and returns its result with bit three cleared and bit one set.

name: call_alternating_library_entries
description: Calls a fixed sequence of library vectors through the library base, alternating between two of them and calling a third once near the middle of the sequence. It returns nothing.

name: run_conditional_vector_sequence
description: Calls two status queries through the library base and branches on their results, calling further library vectors in each branch. It returns the final result with some bits cleared.

name: run_conditional_vector_variant
description: Performs the same branching sequence of library queries and vector calls as its neighbouring routine, but chooses a different final vector based on a branch flag. It returns the final result with some bits cleared.

name: dispatch_vector_by_sign_flags
description: Calls a library vector, then calls a follow-up vector depending on whether a first argument is zero and on the sign of a second argument. It calls one vector or a pair of them, and returns the final result with some bits cleared.

name: dispatch_vector_by_sign_pair
description: Chooses among library vector calls by testing whether a first argument is zero and the sign of a second argument. It calls one vector or a pair of them along the chosen branch, and returns the last result with some bits cleared.

name: select_vector_by_sign_flag
description: Calls one library vector, then calls a pair of vectors when a value is negative, a single vector when a second value is zero, or another pair otherwise. It returns the result with some bits cleared.

name: call_vector_then_mask_result
description: Calls one library vector through the library base and returns its result with some bits cleared.

name: call_vector_twice_mask_result
description: Calls one library vector twice through the library base and then returns the result with some bits cleared.

name: mask_return_value
description: Calls one library vector twice through the library base, then calls another routine and returns its result with some bits cleared. It is identical in form to its neighbouring routine.

name: call_library_vector_414
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library vector at offset minus 414 from that base and does nothing else.

name: call_library_vector_552
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library vector at offset minus 552 from that base, then returns. It does nothing else.

name: compute_bit_serial_quotient
description: Shifts the input by its exponent field, then builds a result bit by bit over up to twenty-four steps by subtracting a trial value and doubling an accumulator. Large exponents take a special path that calls other routines.

name: build_bit_serial_mantissa
description: Runs the same bit-serial loop over up to twenty-four steps as its neighbouring routine, without the exponent normalisation. When the steps run out it calls one routine, and a set flag causes it to call another.

name: execute_loop_with_branching
description: Runs a loop that shifts a value and decrements a counter each pass, calling a routine when the counter reaches minus one. A nonzero flag byte then causes a second routine to be called before the function returns.

name: reduce_angle_and_evaluate
description: Reduces an angle argument by repeated addition and subtraction of fixed constants that look like multiples of pi. It then evaluates a table-driven series to produce a trigonometric-style result, returning early for arguments outside the expected range.

name: reduce_angle_with_zero_check
description: Performs the same angle reduction and table-driven evaluation as its neighbour, with a different input range check. After the final steps it branches on whether the intermediate result is zero, calling one routine or two.

name: evaluate_reduced_angle_series
description: Reduces the angle argument within a fixed range and evaluates a short table-driven series from it. It then calls one routine to finish the result.

name: evaluate_angle_with_sign_flag
description: Returns immediately for small arguments; otherwise it reduces the angle and evaluates the series, then finishes with a branch on a sign argument that selects one of two finishing call sequences.

name: evaluate_angle_series_variant
description: Applies the range check and table-driven series evaluation used by its neighbouring routines, then finishes with a single call.

name: build_mantissa_with_sign_branch
description: Runs a table-driven bit-serial loop over up to twenty-four steps, then finishes with a branch on a sign argument. One path calls two routines and the other calls a single routine.

name: build_mantissa_then_finish
description: Runs a bit-serial loop over up to twenty-four steps to build a mantissa from its inputs. It then finishes with a branch on a sign argument, calling the finishing routines accordingly.

name: build_mantissa_and_store
description: Runs a bit-serial loop over up to twenty-four steps on its input, then finishes with a branch on a sign argument that calls either one routine or several.

name: iterate_rotation_accumulators
description: Runs an iterative update over a table of values, adjusting two accumulators by shifted differences on each pass. It finishes with the same sign-dependent calls as its neighbouring routines.

name: stub_empty_routine
description: Contains only a return, so calling it has no effect.

name: call_own_entry_recursively
description: Calls the routine at its own entry point and then returns, so the code appears to recurse into itself.

name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two other routines in sequence and then returns.

name: normalise_fixed_to_float

name: normalise_fixed_unless_marker

name: call_routine_then_triple
description: Calls one routine and then three more in sequence. The flag guarding these calls is fixed to false, so the three calls always run.

name: call_routines_with_incremented_index
description: When the index argument is nonzero and incrementing it does not overflow, it calls one routine. It then makes two calls with the incremented index and one more call with no argument.

name: sum_table_with_sign_steps
description: Walks a table of longwords, adding each entry while the accumulator is negative and subtracting it otherwise, until the counter reaches its end.

name: subtract_table_from_accumulator

name: build_float_mantissa_scaled

name: run_shift_loop_with_exit

name: call_routine_three_times

name: normalise_and_store_value

name: store_normalised_mantissa

name: normalise_fixed_point_value
description: Normalises a signed 32-bit fixed-point value in the data register by taking its magnitude, swapping its halves when small, and doubling it until the top bit is set. The exponent is decremented once per doubling, and zero returns immediately.

name: return_minus_one_status
description: Returns minus one, with all bits set, and does nothing else. It is library code in the icon library.

name: increment_counter_clear_bit
description: Increments a short counter at offset 32 in the structure and clears bit three of the status byte at offset fourteen.

name: decrement_library_refcount
description: Decrements a short reference counter at offset 32 in the structure. When the counter reaches zero and bit three of the status byte is set, it calls one routine and returns its result; otherwise it returns zero.

name: unlink_entry_and_free
description: If the counter at offset eight is zero, it unlinks the entry from its list, frees it through the exec library and returns the value stored at offset 42. Otherwise it sets bit three of the status byte and returns zero.

name: set_node_flag_return_zero
description: Sets bit three of the status byte at offset fourteen in the structure and returns zero.
